reply:
localStorage is shared across all tabs of the same origin; sessionStorage is per-tab. That reverses my verdict.

Your flag in localStorage will sync across tabs automatically. When the second tab reads it, the login state is there. This explains the auto-login behavior the users report.

The question becomes: is that the intended behavior, or should the login state be sessionStorage (tab-isolated) instead? That depends on your product design—do you want one login to affect all tabs, or each tab independent?

grade.note: Reply accepts correction, correctly explains localStorage cross-tab sharing mechanism, and applies it to the login scenario.
